newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q2 CONSTRUCTION STARTS UP 20 PCT YR/YR -SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q2 CONSTRUCTION STARTS UP 20 PCT YR/YR -SF.

text.p: The volume of construction starts in in the second quarter rose 20 percent to 9.60 million cubic metres, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
The number of housing starts rose 11 percent to 7,640, it said.
Industrial construction starts fell nine percent by volume to 1.65 million cubic metres but total industry and warehouse starts rose 12 percent to 2.68 million cubic metres, SF said.
